defense_news.title: Lithuania says it would pay the cost if US establishes military base
defense_news.summary: Lithuania is ready to pay the cost to set up a permanent U.S. military base if Washington should agree to establish one there, the prime minister said.

defense_news.title: Boeing locks in 7-year deal to triple PAC-3 MSE seeker output
defense_news.summary: The agreement follows a framework deal that was announced in April. Production will span seven years and be completed at Boeing’s Huntsville facility.

defense_news.title: Has the Pentagon given up on AI polygraph analysis of trustworthiness?
defense_news.summary: AI-aided scanning of speech patterns, vocal stress or facial expressions to read minds lacks scientific backing and will compound errors, critics argue.

defense_news.title: US Army tests counter-drone tech at Mexican border as cartel drone use rises
defense_news.summary: The service is seeking to sharpen its defenses against the growing threat of drone use by cartels.

geo_news.summary: Muğla'nın Fethiye ilçesinde deniz kaplumbağalarının yuva yaptığı sahillerden, bu üreme döneminde yaklaşık 6 bin caretta caretta yavrusu denize ulaştı.
